dev.intro: The shared components of the admin panel. Open in development only.
dev.emptyText: The first booking will show up here.
dev.confirmText: A closed branch is not shown on the site. You can reopen it at any time.
dev.toastFailed: It could not be saved. Try again.

promoCodes.title: Campaign codes
promoCodes.intro: The discount codes entered on the booking summary. A code you add can be used at once.
promoCodes.newIntro: As soon as the code is created it can be used on the booking summary.
promoCodes.detailIntro: Used in {used} bookings so far. Created on {created}.
promoCodes.emptyText: Add the first one; it can be used on the booking summary at once.
promoCodes.emptyFilteredText: Try removing the filter or searching for another code.
promoCodes.loadErrorTitle: The codes could not be loaded
promoCodes.loadErrorText: Try again in a few seconds.

fields.codeHint: Letters and digits, 3 to 20 characters. Made upper case; it cannot be changed later.
fields.codeFixed: The name of a code cannot be changed; make a new code for another name.
fields.percentHint: A number from 1 to 90. It comes off the car and extras together.
fields.validUntilHint: This day included. If empty, no end date. Istanbul time.
fields.maxRedemptionsHint: How many bookings can use the code. If empty, no limit.
fields.maxRedemptionsHintUsed: If empty, no limit. Used in {used} bookings so far; the limit cannot be lower.
fields.oncePerUser: Each account can use the code only once
fields.active: Code is on (when off, it is applied to no booking)

errors.code: Enter a code of 3 to 20 characters, letters and digits only.
errors.percent: Enter a whole number from 1 to 90.
errors.validUntil: The last day cannot be before the first day.
errors.dateRange: The last day must be after the first day.
errors.maxRedemptions: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.
errors.belowUsage: The limit cannot be lower than the uses so far ({used}).
errors.taken: A code with this name already exists.
errors.generic: This was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
errors.notFound: This code no longer exists. Go back to the list.
errors.unavailable: It could not be saved. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.staleShort: Someone else changed this code in the meantime. The current version was loaded; try again.

actions.title: Switch off or delete the code
actions.usedText: This code was used in {used} bookings. Switched off, it is applied to no new booking and the old ones do not change.
actions.unusedText: This code was never used in a booking; you can delete it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the code {code}?
deleteDialog.text: A deleted code cannot be brought back and is no longer applied on the booking summary.

deactivateDialog.title: Switch off the code {code}?
deactivateDialog.text: A code that is off is applied to no new booking. The amount of existing bookings does not change. You can switch it on again at any time.

inUseDialog.title: {code} cannot be deleted
inUseDialog.text: {code} was used in at least one booking, and the past records carry its name. Instead of deleting it you can switch it off: it is applied to no new booking and the old ones do not change.
